queries.evidence_ja: たゞ静かに安らかにぢっと微笑《ほゝゑみ》をつゞけてゐるばかりであって
queries.reason: 安らかに is an adverb modifying how they go on smiling (peacefully/quietly at peace), but 'at rest' recasts it as a separate state and, using the same {t:rest} token as 安息 in p17, blurs the ledger's required distinction between 安らかさ (peace) and 安息 (rest, possibly eternal).

queries.evidence_ja: 深い〳〵安らかさが彼等のすべてに表はれてゐるのであった
queries.reason: 安らかさ here is a noun (peacefulness) shown in/on all of them; rendering it with the same {t:rest} token flattens the 安らかさ chord (sleepy peace p3 → deep peace here) into the 安息 word reserved for p17.
queries.say: a deep, deep {t:rest} showed over all of them

queries.evidence_ja: そして過去った其日に初めて總てが、總ての事が懐しみと許しとに変る事だらう
queries.reason: 初めて is 'for the first time / only then', marking first occurrence, not an exclusive 'only on that day'; 'only' hardens the deliberately unfixed doctrine into a sharper, more theological claim than the Japanese makes. Also 其日 is a vague deictic - the {t:that-day} token is correct, but 'only' leans it toward a decided eschatology the house reading forbids.
queries.say: only on {t:that-day} when it has passed will everything, all things, change
queries.span: only on {t:that-day} when it has passed
queries.suggested_fix: on that day, when it has passed, everything will for the first time change

queries.evidence_ja: そして其時彼等は永久に夜の様な安息の前にあるのであった
queries.reason: Japanese couples a past narrative frame (のであった) with present ある - they *are* before the rest. English simple past 'were before' locates the three safely in a concluded past, against the standing rule not to complete the vision with past-tense summary; the vision should still be going on. 'a rest like night, forever' also detaches 永久に from 安息 (an eternal, night-like rest) so 'forever' floats.
queries.say: they were before a {t:rest} like night, forever
queries.span: they were before a {t:rest} like night, forever
queries.suggested_fix: they are before an eternal rest like night

queries.evidence_ja: 遠い絵が暗く静かに、彼女の眼の底に映ってゐた
queries.reason: 映ってゐた = was reflected/shown (as an image in her eyes); 'lay' drops the reflection and makes the picture a physical object resting in her eyes, losing the picture-in-the-eyes quality the reading stresses ('at once in her eyes, in the future').
queries.say: The far picture lay dark and quiet in the bottom of her eyes
queries.span: lay dark and quiet in the bottom of her eyes
queries.suggested_fix: was reflected dark and quiet in the bottom of her eyes

queries.evidence_ja: 淋しい安らかさを持って、その絵が見えるのであった
queries.reason: 安らかさ is the peace word of the recurring chord, not 安息; {t:rest} imports the p17 eternal-rest word into her lonely peacefulness and weakens the distinction the ledger asks to keep.
queries.say: with a lonely {t:rest}, that picture could be seen

data.say: Vision terms need care on this page: 安らかさ/安息 are being conflated under one 'rest' token, and p17's past 'were' risks closing a vision that must stay open and ongoing.
